random-perks-bingo.perk.swift_speed.name: Light Feet
random-perks-bingo.perk.swift_jump.name: Spring Legs
random-perks-bingo.perk.swift_wind_strid: Move an extra 20% faster while sprinting.
random-perks-bingo.perk.swift_tailwind.d: +10% movement speed; +3% more for each other Swift perk.
random-perks-bingo.perk.swift_elytra_bon: Gain 2 firework rockets, automatically equip a permanently bound elytra, -30% movement speed.
random-perks-bingo.perk.swift_life_bucke: On lethal fall damage, a water bucket in your inventory uses its water and triggers a totem of undying effect.
random-perks-bingo.perk.delver_vein_scen: Mining ores has an 8% chance to drop an extra copy, +3% for each other Delver perk.
random-perks-bingo.perk.delver_xray_visi: Ores within 10 blocks glow; 35% of items you mine with a pickaxe vanish.
random-perks-bingo.perk.delver_lucky_dig: Pickaxe mining can drop a random item, scaling with tier (wood 0.1% / stone 0.5% / iron 1% / diamond+ 10%).
random-perks-bingo.perk.delver_collector: 40% extra drop from ores/stone; -50% mining speed.
random-perks-bingo.perk.delver_phoenix.d: Immune to fire damage; regenerate 2 HP per second in lava.
random-perks-bingo.perk.delver_onion_cut: Right-click obsidian with a pickaxe to turn it into crying obsidian, and vice versa.
random-perks-bingo.perk.delver_eighty.de: Mining stone (including netherrack/basalt/blackstone) with a pickaxe also breaks the 3x3 area of the same block facing you; their drops are settled together with the mined block.
random-perks-bingo.perk.delver_chain_min: Mining an ore with a pickaxe also breaks connected ores of the same type (up to 64); their drops are settled together with the mined ore.
random-perks-bingo.perk.harvest_lumberja: Gain an Efficiency III stone axe.
random-perks-bingo.perk.harvest_timber.d: Chopping an un-stripped log has a 10% chance to drop a stripped log of another wood type.
random-perks-bingo.perk.harvest_bounty.d: Gain 32 carrots and a Fortune III hoe.
random-perks-bingo.perk.harvest_bountifu: Eating a food with full hunger grants a random positive stew effect (2× duration).
Eating any food restores 100% more hunger and saturation.
random-perks-bingo.perk.hunter_scavenger: 30% chance of extra loot from mobs.
random-perks-bingo.perk.hunter_soul_harv: 10% chance for an extra drop matching the slain mob (e.g. zombies drop iron, ghasts drop ghast tears).
random-perks-bingo.perk.hunter_marked_pr: Nearest enemy always marked (direction, coords, distance); +50% speed within 256 blocks.
random-perks-bingo.perk.hunter_greedy_ha: 50% chance of an extra loot drop on kill; but you take double damage from mobs.
Killing a mob restores 2 hunger and 2 saturation.
random-perks-bingo.perk.hunter_headhunte: Permanently +2 max health for each enemy player you kill.
random-perks-bingo.perk.hunter_bare_rage: +40% attack damage while wearing no armor.
random-perks-bingo.perk.artisan_supply.d: Gain 16 bread and a water bucket.
Gain an Efficiency II iron pickaxe with 24 durability.
Gain a crafting table, 16 logs, cobblestone and torches.
random-perks-bingo.perk.artisan_fire_tem: Gain a blast furnace, a smoker and a campfire.
random-perks-bingo.perk.artisan_enchante: Gain a max-level enchanted book, then another every 6 minutes.
random-perks-bingo.perk.artisan_quick_en: Click it in your perk list to choose one of your items and gain a random max-level enchantment.
random-perks-bingo.perk.artisan_poisoner: Choose any player: inflict a random debuff for 30 seconds.
random-perks-bingo.perk.artisan_treasure: Open 1~5 random pieces of armor or tools up to diamond tier.
random-perks-bingo.perk.seeker_scout.des: Gain a marking spyglass, a compass and a treasure map.
random-perks-bingo.perk.seeker_pickpocke: Pick an enemy player to open their inventory and steal one item.
random-perks-bingo.perk.seeker_life_visi: Continuously outline all non-player mobs within 32 blocks.
random-perks-bingo.perk.seeker_ender_cac: Gain an ender chest now, then one every 10 minutes.
random-perks-bingo.perk.seeker_alchemist: Gain a random potion, then another every 2 minutes.
random-perks-bingo.perk.harvest_cat_aura: Creepers fear you like they fear cats and flee from you; while in water, you get a random fish every 5 seconds.
Gain 16 fire charges: launch ghast-like fireballs that cannot be deflected.
random-perks-bingo.perk.summon_horse.des: Summon a horse with high attributes where you stand; it teleports to you like a tamed wolf.
random-perks-bingo.perk.harvest_big_stom: You can keep eating regardless of your hunger level.
random-perks-bingo.perk.harvest_yowl.des: Cats no longer fear you and will attack you instead, but killing a cat always drops 3 string.
random-perks-bingo.perk.summon_big_dog.d: Summon 2 high-attribute wolves of your own.
random-perks-bingo.perk.summon_wandering: Spawns a wandering trader with trader llamas.
random-perks-bingo.perk.seeker_village_c: Gain a lodestone compass pointing to the nearest village.
random-perks-bingo.perk.summon_call_ligh: Pick any player and summon lightning on them; nearby lightning rods redirect it.
random-perks-bingo.perk.summon_dragon_ta: Right-click a mob to ride it (players and bosses excluded). Steer with WASD; right-click to make the mount use its ability; sneak to dismount.
random-perks-bingo.message.dragon_tamer_: ★ Dragon Tamer: right-click a mob to ride it; right-click while riding to use its ability; sneak to dismount.
You mounted %s — steer with WASD, right-click to use its ability, sneak to dismount.
random-perks-bingo.perk.artisan_midas_to: Right-click gilded blackstone to turn it into a gold block.
random-perks-bingo.perk.summon_remote_tr: Activate from the perk list, choose a teammate, then pick 4 item slots from your inventory to send.
random-perks-bingo.perk.harvest_kelp_to_: Right-click a dried kelp block to turn it into a bone block.
random-perks-bingo.perk.harvest_bone_mea: When using bone meal on a grass block, 30% chance to grow 2 extra random flowers.
random-perks-bingo.perk.hunter_veteran.d: Your sword becomes a pre-1.9 sword.
random-perks-bingo.perk.hunter_easy_nuke: Choose any player: a glowing charged creeper spawns above them.
random-perks-bingo.perk.hunter_homing_bo: Gain a bow and 4 tipped arrows every 2 min. Arrows lock onto the enemy closest to your crosshair within 64 blocks when fired (walls ignored) and pass through blocks while homing.
random-perks-bingo.perk.hunter_jockey.de: Right-click a player to ride and steer them; their damage to you -75%. Shift to dismount. Your victim can break free with 30 WASD presses, after which you are on cooldown for 3 minutes.
random-perks-bingo.perk.harvest_pig_morp: Pig form: pig-size view and hitbox, fit 1-block gaps. Head keeps your skin. +1 golden carrot / 30s.
random-perks-bingo.perk.summon_big_snowb: Gain 32 snowballs; yours are bigger, hit harder (3 damage) and knock targets flying.
random-perks-bingo.perk.mythic_hodgepodg: Choose any player: every item in their inventory becomes a random different item.
random-perks-bingo.perk.hunter_demon_pac: You deal double damage, but you also take double damage from everything.
random-perks-bingo.perk.hunter_pearl_gau: Every attack crits; swords no longer sweep, and you permanently have Mining Fatigue I.
random-perks-bingo.perk.seeker_random_gr: Replaces each block in the 3x3 area under your feet with a random block.
random-perks-bingo.perk.swift_escape_pla: Taking damage from a living thing grants Speed II and Resistance I for 10 seconds.
random-perks-bingo.perk.swift_dash.name: Dash
random-perks-bingo.perk.swift_dash.desc: Press sneak in mid-air to dash forward (once per airtime, 3s cooldown).
random-perks-bingo.perk.hunter_satiation: While your hunger bar is full, you deal 50% more damage but get hungry faster.
random-perks-bingo.perk.summon_pokemon.d: Gain 4 eggs; when your thrown egg hits a non-boss mob, it turns into its spawn egg.
Blindness + Slowness IV for 5 minutes; then gain Nature's/Explorer's Compass, or a stone axe if you die.
random-perks-bingo.message.lay_flat_miss: Nature's Compass / Explorer's Compass is not installed; this reward was skipped.
random-perks-bingo.perk.seeker_magnet_up: Pickup range 5 blocks; right-click a shulker box or ender chest to open it. Sneak to place.
random-perks-bingo.perk.artisan_temperin: Gain a one-use damaged anvil, a furnace and a stonecutter.
random-perks-bingo.perk.harvest_gleaning: Harvesting a mature crop has a 50% chance to drop an extra random seed.
random-perks-bingo.perk.harvest_beekeepe: Breaking a bee nest or beehive also drops 2 honeycomb and 8 honey bottles.
random-perks-bingo.perk.summon_happy_gha: Summon a Happy Ghast wearing a harness with permanent Speed I, and gain 2 leads.
random-perks-bingo.perk.seeker_warm_arch: Gain a brush. Brushing coral turns it dead and drops ocean ruins loot; 10% is its matching mineral.
random-perks-bingo.perk.summon_swap.name: Swap
random-perks-bingo.perk.summon_swap.desc: Choose two players and swap their positions.
random-perks-bingo.perk.seeker_old_pries: Gain 16 emeralds and spawn a master cleric villager; 0–3 of his trades are randomly out of stock.
random-perks-bingo.perk.harvest_dingdong: Gain 4 chicken spawn eggs; dye any chicken into the matching color-variant breed.
random-perks-bingo.perk.harvest_lucky_fi: Luck +8; each catch has an extra 10% chance to include a nautilus shell.
random-perks-bingo.message.old_priest_fa: No room to stand nearby, so the Old Priest could not spawn.
random-perks-bingo.perk.summon_tnt_throw: Gain 4 TNT; TNT can be thrown to explode.
random-perks-bingo.perk.hunter_munitions: Gain 1 end crystal, 4 TNT, 6 fire charges and 8 gunpowder.
random-perks-bingo.perk.hunter_bounty_hu: Killing a hostile mob type for the first time grants 3 gold ingots.
random-perks-bingo.perk.harvest_fungal_i: When you hit an enemy player, 2 random items in their inventory turn into lush cave items (30s cooldown).
random-perks-bingo.perk.harvest_slow_che: While eating food, you take 65% less damage.
random-perks-bingo.perk.delver_carefree_: Sleeping in a bed in the Nether or the End doubles the explosion radius and deals 1.5x damage.

random-perks-bingo.perk.artisan_waypoint: Gain a clock: right-click to teleport to your last death spot, 5 min cooldown.

random-perks-bingo.perk.seeker_supply_li: Gain a random supply, then another every 2 minutes.
random-perks-bingo.perk.seeker_ender_sup: Gain an ender pearl, then another every 5 minutes.
random-perks-bingo.perk.seeker_puny.name: Puny!?
random-perks-bingo.perk.seeker_puny.desc: Choose any player: they get 4 of a random mineral, plus a silverfish within 5 blocks every 6s for 2 min.
